reason: Yes for the narrow definitional fix only, not for the 99%-unreadable headline. I accept the Clerk's finding that the 1090-1093 unreadable entries are an out-of-date Act 21 checker that does not recognise Act 26 records, which the Executive can fix without law. The distinct defect this bill addresses is real: a carrier commit containing records/suite-status.json has a tree different from the candidate it records, and Act 21 s5's unqualified tree-equality demand is not satisfiable for that carrier even after Act 26. The bill is an express amendment (s2.2), names base/candidate/carrier and one fast-forward (s2.3), states that Git evidence is consistency not execution proof (s2.4), separates reporting (s2.5), and adds ten negative fixtures. Both non-sponsor red-teams are integrated verbatim and all eleven objections are answered; O5/B5's cost-benefit and informal-reading residues remain open, and I accept them knowingly because no written interpretation meeting s5a(4) exists. Act 22 passed as not_exercised outside the pilot; I do not treat that as a bar. This yes does not claim the compliance rate is restored.
